text:
Alex G: noticed a sudden spike in 502/504s for hosted inference from ap-east customers ~10:30 UTC. grafana shows packet loss on egress for ap-east1 across multiple AZs. tickets coming in from two large customers. opening an incident thread.

Sunil R: confirming -- I'm seeing increased tail latency and gateway 502s in the api-gateway logs for region=ap-east1. 95p token latency jumps and then 502s for POST /v1/generate.

Maria (CS): we've got 3 escalations via support+pagerduty. customers report timeouts during batch inference, some see repeated 502s then fallback to retries. they provided curl logs showing repeated 502s.

Tayla - SRE: can we get a quick repro? sample curl from customer: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-13b","input":"hello"}' -v
```
response snippets: 
```
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "gateway_error",
  "message": "upstream read timeout"
}
```
They also included packet captures to our support bucket.

networking-oncall-bot: detected BGP flaps on transit-provider-2 peering to ap-east1 egress path at 10:28 UTC. Flap count: 12 in 3m. Potential asymmetric routing causing packet loss.

Alex G: interesting — grafana of network egress counters shows TX errors on the egress interface from the edge routers, but internal VM NICs look fine. that points at provider/edge.

Sunil R: quick mitigation idea: shift ap-east1 hosted traffic to ap-southeast-1 pool via smart-routing fallback policy for model=rw-13b and canary rule for the next 15m. apply now? :thinking_face:

Tayla - SRE: +1 for short failover. we'll also increase retry and reduce client timeout to avoid long waits. adding a temporary route-policy: 
```yaml
routing_override:
  region: ap-east1
  fallback_region: ap-southeast-1
  duration: 15m
  reason: "egress packet loss due to transit-provider-2 BGP flaps"
```

deploy-bot: patch queued to routing-configs repo (PR #482) by tayla. rolling out in 30s.

Maria (CS): communicating to customers now: telling them we have failover in progress and to expect improved success rates within ~5-10m. ticket links: TKT-3451, TKT-3454.

Sunil R: after failover started: success rate back to normal for most calls; 502s dropped from 18% -> 0.8% within 4 minutes. tracing shows requests now hitting ap-southeast-1 nodes.

Alex G: logging snapshots collected. key artifacts: api-gateway logs (gateway_upstream_read_timeout), network edge counters, transit-provider syslogs (provided by provider). attaching location: s3://redwood-incidents/1811043200/ap-east1-egress/*.pcap,*.logs

networking-oncall-bot: provider reports they observed a misconfiguration in egress MPLS path causing microloops during BGP reconvergence; they are working a fix.

Tayla - SRE: post-incident actions IANA: 1) keep routing failover policy for region on standby for 72h; 2) add automated detection rule: if region 5xx rate > 5% && egress packet loss > 1% -> auto-failover to secondary region after 90s; 3) update runbook with provider escalation steps and exact packet-capture upload path.

Maria (CS): customers updated, credit offers for impacted windows. got +1 from legal on wording.

Alex G: moving to postmortem. initial root-cause: transit-provider-2 BGP instability causing asymmetric/e2e packet loss on ap-east1 egress, leading to upstream read timeouts at the gateway. mitigations: regional failover and routing policy changes. followups assigned.

Tayla - SRE: assigning action items: 
- Tayla: implement auto-failover detection & test in staging by next sprint.
- Sunil: coordinate with provider for confirmed RCA and closure.
- Maria: finalize customer comms and credits.
- Alex: draft incident postmortem and timeline.

Sunil R: logged as incident-2026-03-15-AP-EAST-EGRESS-01. closing active alert but keeping thread open until provider confirms permanent fix. :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): thanks all. lessons: be ready to fail regional traffic fast; add doc snippet for CS on how to explain regional network failures to customers. :heart:

deploy-bot: routing-configs PR #482 merged and rolled to control-plane in 45s.

Alex G: note for postmortem — include exact query sample, gateway logs, and pcap timeline. I'll start draft.

Tayla - SRE: adding to ops board and scheduling a follow-up call with provider tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

networking-oncall-bot: provider confirmed permanent fix at 11:05 UTC; BGP flaps resolved. monitoring back to baseline.

Alex G: incident resolved; root cause and mitigations captured. will publish postmortem when draft complete. :tada:
